ESMA finalises guidelines on test data retention

Market Abuse

ESMA has published final guidelines requiring firms to retain order records for five years.

The guidelines apply from 1 January 2027. Final report (PDF)

Key requirements

  • Firms must retain order records for five years.
  • Records must be made available to the competent authority on request.
